quota_details.description: Adjacent to remaining, represents quota details including next available and applicable frequency per verb, operation level or uber level.

next_available.description: tells in seconds when next transactions will become available. Value will be -1 if transactions are still remaining for the the user.

remaining.description: tells how many transactions are remaining for the verb. 0 means none remaining, positive integer tells the count that are remaining, -1 means unlimited transactions remaining.

frequency.description: the frequency at which quota refreshes. Value will be -1 when frequency is not applicable, like when user has unlimited transactions.

next_available.description: tells in seconds when next transactions will become available. Value will be -1 if transactions are still remaining for the the user.

remaining.description: tells how many transactions are remaining for the verb. 0 means none remaining, positive integer tells the count that are remaining, -1 means unlimited transactions remaining.

ppt-to-pdf.description: Limits in uber response represents the actual limits provided for user at uber level. Client can refer remaining transactions, next_available and frequency fields. Interpretation of remaining, next_available and frequency is similar to verb response.

configuration.description: various configurations applicable to relevant tile for the user. For example, the max_file_size field which signifies the maximum file size that is support for this tile/pdf operation. More fields wrt operation configuration can be added here as and when needed.

max_file_size.description: Maximum file size supported by the operation, if applicable
